Barlow Semi Condensed (SemiBold 600, Bold 700), the Global Defensive HUD font (v53 stage 4).
From https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/barlowsemicondensed, unchanged TrueType files.
Named .ttf.bin because the game server serves only known file types (.bin = application/octet-stream; browsers load fonts whatever the type).
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, OFL-BarlowSemiCondensed.txt.
